name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. Domain field_menu, descriptor enumerates the 4 dispatched options (status/save/load/quit). No address residue; option list is semantic, not a Ghidra suffix. Name accurately reflects: field command-menu sub-dispatcher that pops a 4-option cross window and routes to the chosen action. keep.
purpose: Field command-menu sub-dispatcher: pops up the 4-option (Status/Save/Load/Quit) cross-shape window and executes the option the player selects.
logic_summary: Copies the 4-int option-label template (0x51EF5 = {0xC,0xD,0xE,0xF}) and the all-zero state template (0x53F22) into local arrays. Probes FD2.SAV ('rb'): if it fails to open, grays the Load option (menu_state[2]=1); if it opens, malloc+fread+free as a probe only. Scans the party and grays the Save option (menu_state[1]=1) if any char has (flags&1)==0 && (flags&0x80)!=0 (a unit acted but is alive, so the field turn is mid-flight). Opens the slide-in dialog, polls fd2_settings_menu_input_step until non-zero, closes it, recomposites. input_result==-1 (Esc) -> return 0. Otherwise dispatches on data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx: 0 STATUS opens the party status overview, return 1; 1 SAVE prompts (portrait 0x4B, dialog 0x19A), and on YES (typewriter==1 && cursor==0) assembles the 0x59CB FD2.SAV snapshot (probe-read old file or stamp empty-slot 0xFF markers at +0x3B2B/0x4553/0x4F7B/0x59A3, copy live engine state at fixed offsets), computes checksum @ +0x59C7, encrypts, writes ('wb'), dialog 0x19B; on NO/gate-fail dialog 0x19C; return 1; 2 LOAD prompts (dialog 0x19D), and on YES shows dialog 0x19E, fades BGM off, calls fd2_load_save_and_init_engine(), clear-keyboard, return 1; else dialog 0x19C, return 1; 3 QUIT prompts (dialog 0x19F), on YES dialog 0x1A0, fade BGM off, close -> return -1; on NO dialog 0x19C, close -> return 1 (this path does NOT call clear-keyboard, unlike Save/Load cancel). Has the __CHK(0x54) stack-probe prologue.

returns.semantics: 0 = Esc-cancelled selection (field loop continues); 1 = Status/Save/Load completed OR any Save/Load/Quit sub-prompt answered NO (field loop continues); -1 = Quit confirmed (field loop aborts, return to title).

comment_original_issue: Header summary stated the QUIT 'On NO' path returns -1, but the code (and the more detailed inline comment at the QUIT-NO tail) returns 1. Also the Returns line omitted that return 1 covers Save/Load/Quit sub-prompt NO cases (the Ghidra plate already captured this nuance).
